problem: main RAF供應physics/render/input，搬遷可能隔離長任務但也增加命令、snapshot與同步成本。

evidence_basis.locator: dedicated simulation worker為建議未實作
evidence_basis.version: 以來源內版本／日期為準；不得合併R17、05d40與R21 dirty
evidence_basis.sha256_status: Bound to actual research-worktree bytes at registration; historical version scope retained
Bound to actual research-worktree bytes at registration; historical version scope retained

proposed_solution: 只有前序profile仍證main physics限制時，建立可替換adapter與單一simulation owner，帶sequence/tick/revision/epoch的命令與last-complete snapshots，render只讀插值。
alternatives: 保留main fixed-step並先窄化capture／view成本。
分批offline固定tick推進，不變interactive ownership。
expected_benefit: 可能減少view對simulation排程的耦合；Worker無實時或背景完成保證。
complexity: 很高；命令原子性／undo／重置及全部host接線。
performance_impact: end-to-end command latency、worker CPU/wall、snapshot delivery/copies與main尾端一併量。
audio_quality_impact: physics trace、events及聲學source timing不可變成不同實驗。
latency_impact: 額外message hop需量；audio callback不能等待worker。
compatibility_regression_risk: revision race、handle持久化、舊generation reply及render反寫pose破壞權威。
benchmark_plan: 固定step reference、catch-up/overload、grab throw contact、atomic command undo、reset/import/dispose/cancel、worker crash及同scene/render stall。
rollback_plan: 停止命令接納，drain或拒絕pending，固定完整snapshot並銷毀worker資源；僅在可驗state交接點切回main adapter，否則明示需reset，不能默換不同狀態。
priority_rationale: 架構及回歸成本高；P0/P1窄修後仍有證據才投入。
validation_status: NOT RUN — future implementation and candidate validation
compatibility_risk: Worker/WASM/thread scheduling differs; no background realtime guarantee.
regression_risk: Command ordering, undo, contact physics and recording determinism may regress.
